brief.company_summary: NSE-listed Indian cloud and AI infrastructure provider (GPU cloud), headquartered in Delhi. Larsen & Toubro has been a minority strategic shareholder since a deal announced in November 2024.

signals.title: New Chief Revenue Officer, Anand Ganapathy, effective 24 September 2026
signals.detail: About 27 years in enterprise technology sales, previously leading IBM India's Enterprise AI and Hybrid Cloud business, with earlier roles at Dell Technologies and VMware. The company says he will lead the revenue function and build the go-to-market engine around long-term contracted customers. The previous CRO resigned effective 30 June 2026.
signals.navigator_angle: A CRO two months into the role with a mandate to build the GTM engine is reviewing team, process and tooling right now. This is the best-timed conversation on the account.

signals.title: Q2 FY27 revenue up 411% year on year to ₹2,238 Mn
signals.detail: Quarter ended 30 September 2026: revenue up 43% on the previous quarter, EBITDA margin 76.6%, profit after tax ₹727 Mn against a loss a year earlier. Growth is driven by demand for Blackwell GPUs.
signals.navigator_angle: Strong profit and momentum mean budget exists for sales expansion and tooling is unlikely to be blocked on cost.

signals.title: Binding term sheet of about ₹1,000 crore with an Indian sovereign AI customer
signals.detail: Runs to June 2029 and moves an existing GPU cluster from pay-as-you-go to a multi-year commitment. Management is steering the business toward long-term contracted enterprise customers.
signals.navigator_angle: A shift from self-serve usage to large contracted deals means enterprise selling into multi-person buying committees, which is where Sales Navigator is most useful.

signals.title: Four open sales roles, weighted toward enterprise sellers
signals.detail: Job boards show an Enterprise Sales role in Mumbai / Bengaluru (10 to 15 years, targeting funded startups, unicorns and global capability centres) and an Enterprise Sales Manager for banking, financial services and insurance accounts in Karnataka and Maharashtra. An Inside Sales Executive (Delhi NCR) and an Assistant Vice President, Commercial (Delhi) were listed last week and could not be re-confirmed this week.
signals.navigator_angle: Sellers are being hired by segment (BFSI, startups, capability centres) and by region. Each is a new territory to map and a seat needed from day one.

signals.title: Data centre capacity expansion for AI compute
signals.detail: The company told the exchanges on 12 November 2026 that it secured about 12.8 MW of additional capacity on top of roughly 14.6 MW, following a 5.4 MW addition announced in October. The totals come from secondary reports and are approximate.
signals.navigator_angle: More capacity has to be sold. Expect pressure on the sales team to fill it with contracted customers.

signals.title: Launched Blaze, a pay-per-token AI inference service
signals.detail: New product line reported in November 2026, aimed at teams running open AI models.
signals.navigator_angle: A new product opens a new buyer group (AI and ML engineering leaders) the sales team will need to reach.

signals.title: New wholly owned US subsidiary, Jarvis Labs AI Inc.
signals.detail: Disclosed to the exchanges on 20 November 2026, effective 19 November, for USD 40,000. Reports differ on whether this is an acquisition of an existing company or a newly incorporated Delaware entity; either way it gives E2E a US arm for its cloud GPU business.
signals.navigator_angle: A US entity usually means US customers to win. Ask who will sell into the US and whether that team sits under the existing agreement.

signals.title: ICRA upgraded bank facilities to A (Positive) from A- (Stable)
signals.navigator_angle: Further evidence of financial strength behind the expansion.

signals.title: Share price fell about 15% in the week of 16 to 20 November
signals.detail: The stock hit its lower circuit limit on four days and closed near ₹475 while the wider market rose. No cause has been disclosed.
signals.navigator_angle: Not a reason to hold back, since results and hiring are strong, but be aware of it: leadership may be more cost-conscious in the short term.

talk_track: Anand Ganapathy joined as CRO in late September with a brief to build the GTM engine. Ask for an introduction and offer a review of how the team prospects today.
Sales hiring is now by segment: enterprise, BFSI, startups and capability centres. Each new seller starts with an empty territory, so agree how they get seats in week one.
A US subsidiary, Jarvis Labs AI Inc., was disclosed on 20 November. Ask who will own US selling and whether they are covered by the current agreement.
The business is moving from pay-as-you-go to multi-year enterprise contracts. That is committee selling, which is where account mapping in Sales Navigator pays off.

email.subject: Supporting the enterprise sales build-out
email.body:
Hi [Name],

Congratulations on the Q2 results and on Anand joining as CRO. It looks like a big moment for the revenue team, with new enterprise and BFSI sales hires and the US entity announced last week.

As the team grows by segment and region, I would like to make sure Sales Navigator keeps up: new starters get access on day one, the right people have seats, and account mapping reflects the enterprise buyers you are now targeting, including in the US.

Could we find 30 minutes in the next two weeks? If it is useful, I would also welcome an introduction to Anand so I can understand his priorities for the team.

Best regards,
[Your name]

brief.caveats: The company's own careers page could not be read, so open roles come from job boards and may be incomplete; two of the four roles (Inside Sales Executive and Assistant Vice President, Commercial) could not be re-confirmed this week. Reports conflict on whether Jarvis Labs AI Inc. was acquired or newly incorporated. Current seat count is not entered. No layoffs or leadership departures were found.
brief.play: Get an introduction to the new CRO, Anand Ganapathy, this month. Four sales roles are open across enterprise, BFSI and inside sales, and a US subsidiary was set up last week, so ask for a seat plan that covers the new sellers and whoever will sell into the US.

contacts.why: Owns the revenue function and the GTM build-out. New in role since 24 September 2026, so tooling decisions are open.

contacts.who: Whoever is hiring the Enterprise Sales and BFSI sales roles
contacts.why: Regional and segment sales heads in Mumbai, Bengaluru and across Karnataka and Maharashtra feel the ramp-time problem first. Search Sales Navigator for sales directors and regional heads at the account.

contacts.who: Sales operations or revenue operations lead
contacts.why: Usually manages seat allocation and onboarding. Your route to a seats-on-day-one process for new hires.
Start here for the introduction to the CRO and for current seat usage.
